title: Gulf View Condo w/ Pool – Watersound 30A FL
meta_description: You’ll delight in “resorting to” this 30A vacay rental year after year. Even with an address of 100 S. Spooky Lane, there’s nothing scary about three floors of modern amenities in the middle of one of Mother Nature’s most glorious attractions!
description_expanded: AboutGrace by the Gulf on 30A – Modern Beachfront Luxury on 30A Santa Rosa Beach | 3 Bedrooms | Sleeps 8 | Townhome in Beachfront Community Why Guests Love Grace by the Gulf on 30A, a 30A Vacation Rental: • Huge beach for this community • Gated community • Unbeatable Beach Location – Steps to the Gulf of Mexico • Breathtaking Gulf Views – Enjoy sunsets from multiple balconies • Olympic-Sized Community Pool and Hot Tub – Perfect for relaxing after a beach day • Golf Cart - Huge Savings! Add the Street Legal Golf Cart and receive a Big Discount off Cart Rate • Stylish and Modern Interiors – Professionally designed for ultimate comfort • Outdoor Grill and Alfresco Dining – Ideal for beachside cookouts • Prime 30A Location – Walk to Gulf Place, Shunk Gulley's, dining, shopping, and entertainment • TV in every bedroom • Two parking spaces • Four folding beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Starter amenities in bathroom and kitchen including Starbucks coffee and bottles of water A Contemporary Coastal Escape Perched right along the pristine shores of Santa Rosa Beach, Grace by the Gulf on 30A is an ultra-modern, end-unit townhome designed for those seeking the ultimate beachfront escape. With expansive Gulf views, high-end decor, and private balconies, this vacation rental offers a stylish and serene retreat for families and friends. The first-floor king suite provides a private sanctuary with an ensuite bathroom, while the main living area on the second floor features plush seating, a flat-screen TV, and an open-concept kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Step outside onto the balcony for alfresco dining, complete with a grill and stunning Gulf views. On the third floor, the primary king suite boasts a private ocean-view balcony, perfect for sipping morning coffee as the waves roll in. A bunk room with queen-over-queen beds provides the perfect retreat for kids or extra guests. Explore Santa Rosa Beach: • Walk directly onto the beach via a scenic boardwalk • Visit Gulf Place for dining, live music, and boutique shopping • Bike along 30A’s coastal trails and scenic dune lakes Don’t Miss Out on This Exclusive Beachfront Stay – Book Now! Your dream vacation is just a click away!
